requests.name: Kappa Shader
requests.reason: High detail; realistic, stylized light and volumetric clouds. No DH compatibility is assumed.

requests.name: Bliss Shaders
requests.reason: Fantasy skies and warm, varied lighting; established release selected instead of a floating development branch.

requests.name: Chocapic13 Shaders
requests.reason: The original author’s V9 and V9.1 beta files are legacy OptiFine-era releases without established Iris/DH support. The official CurseForge download refused automated retrieval (HTTP 403), and no authorized API key is present. An unchanged author download and native client test are required; Bliss is documented as a derivative, not substituted for the requested original.

requests.name: Photon Shaders
requests.reason: Balanced to high quality gameplay shaders; this release adds Create Colorwheel integration and configurable atmosphere.

requests.name: MakeUp Ultra Fast
requests.reason: Lighter configurable effects; optional shadows, depth of field and color schemes. No FPS claim before measurement.

requests.name: Solas Shader
requests.reason: Cozy fantasy option with colored lighting, auroras, fireflies and expressive skies; moderate-cost author target.

requests.name: Pastel Shaders (research candidate)
requests.reason: The author’s 1.200 release offers pastel color schemes and a cozy style, but its published version list stops at 1.21 and this exact build’s DH support is unverified. Retained for investigation; Bliss, BSL and Solas provide the initial cozy choices.

evidence_boundary: Pinned metadata/static JAR checks are not client, graphics, feature or multiplayer acceptance.
